title: plugin-auth/plugin-email: an imported user is invited with the password-reset email ("If you didn't request this, ignore this email"), not invitation copy
body:
Filing gate: **(a) a user-visible defect, reproduced, landing named**: misleading copy. `reach:` `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-users` (Setup › Users › Import, the Automatic password policy): every user invited by email receives the password-reset template, whose copy says "We received a request to reset the password… If you didn't request this, ignore this email", although the user requested nothing. Measured on the QA run #23104 (C2b), by the first #23152 dev (report `6140032316`), and again by the second at PR #23342's head `825365af7` (its pin finds the invitation by the template key `auth.password_reset`). Reader who acts: triage, to grade and route (`packages/plugins/plugin-email` templates, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` import); then the owning seat.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H`, at the review of PR #23342 (#23152's fix, which makes the invitation link work and changes no copy). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

- The import invites a user by asking for a password reset on their address (`admin-import-users.ts`), so the email is the `auth.password_reset` template (`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/templates/auth-templates.ts`, about `:78` and `:87`).
- An invited user reads that someone asked to reset a password they never had, and is told to ignore the email if they did not ask. The link itself now lands on the set-password page (after PR #23342), so the copy is the remaining barrier.
- #23152's card noted this as a secondary point; its triage direction did not cover it, and PR #23342 keeps it out of scope.

## Wanted

- An invited user receives invitation copy (who invited them, to what, and "set your password"), not reset copy. Whether that is a distinct template key, template data on the reset template, or another shape is the owning seat's measurement; a new template key or new template data is published surface, so its `Clause-②` line is the claim's to state.
- A pin: the import's email names an invitation, and a user-requested reset still sends the reset copy.

Order: after PR #23342 lands (it owns the import's reset request).

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included: `import users invitation email uses password reset template copy didn't request this ignore auth.password_reset invite` → 2 hits: #23152 (open, the dead link; its body's secondary note is this) and #11544 (closed, an unrelated console tab). None is this.

Dedupe words: import invitation email copy; auth.password_reset invitation; didn't request this import invite; set-password invitation template.
